Feature: Is there ergative alignment of flagging on full NPs?
Comment: Full NP's show a clear ergative alignment. The particles ye/ti mark the intransitive subject (S) and the patient (P) in the absolutive case, while nin/ne mark the agent (A) in the ergative case.
